name: Salt Pavilion
blurb: A coastal pavilion and gardens designed around the tide line.
body:
A coastal pavilion and gardens designed around the tide line.

The brief for Salt Pavilion asked for a landscape project that responds to its setting in Zanzibar, Tanzania. We planned it around light, views and everyday movement, then built it with our own crews.

Materials were chosen to age well on site, and the same team stayed with the project from first sketch to handover in 2023.
